General Specifications: The construction and development of the Outdoor Basketball Court shall be carried out in accorda nce with the applicable standards and guidelines prescribed by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA), Basketball Federation of India (BFI) and Sports Authority of India (SAI). The playi ng area shall be 28 m × 15 m, within the available overall court area of 31 m × 20 m, including th e surrounding safety/run-off area. 2. Flooring Material and Construction: The playing surface shall consist of high-quality, virgin polypropylene (PP) interlocking modular sp orts tiles with UV-resistant properties, suitable for outdoor basketball courts. The tiles shall be inst alled over the existing RCC flooring after undertaking necessary minor repairs and surface prepara tion, wherever required, to ensure proper installation, stability and long-term performance. The flo oring shall be weather-resistant, anti-skid and provided in appropriate bi-color combinations for cl ear demarcation of the playing area. 3. Quality, Safety and Durability: The flooring system shall provide adequate cushioning, shock absorption and playing comfort to minimize the risk of injuries during practice and matches. It shall be resistant to UV radiation, fung al growth and adverse weather conditions. The flooring material shall withstand temperature varia tions ranging from -40°C to +80°C and shall have a basketball ball rebound performance of at lea st 97%. The bidder shall submit a test report issued by an accredited laboratory, clearly specifying the applicable testing standard, methodology and actual ball rebound percentage achieved by the proposed PP modular flooring system. The rebound performance shall be verified against the test method applicable to the proposed flooring system. A generic product declaration or manufacturer 's self-declaration without supporting test results shall not be accepted as evidence of compliance with the 97% rebound requirement. The flooring system shall be suitable for outdoor use and designed for a minimum service li fe of 10 years.

4. Technical Standards and Certifications: The materials and equipment used shall conform to applicable international and national quality a nd safety standards. The PP modular sports flooring shall comply with EN 14877:2013 or higher or an equivalent applicable standard for synthetic surfaces used in outdoor sports areas. Relevant te st reports, technical specifications and quality certificates shall be submitted along with the techni cal bid. 5. Bidder Eligibility and Experience: a. Only manufacturers/authorized dealers/distributors having wide experience in dealing wi th the installation of outdoor sports infrastructure may participate in the bidding process. b. The bidder shall have a minimum experience of 5 (five) years in the field of sports infras tructure. c. The bidder must have successfully executed at least 01 (one) similar projects involving t he supply, installation and commissioning of outdoor basketball courts during the last 03 (t hree) years in Government organizations, Public Sector Enterprises, District/State Sports A ssociations or other recognized organizations. d. Copies of relevant work orders, project reports, completion certificates and experience c ertificates issued by the concerned organizations shall be submitted along with the technic al bid. The certificates should contain the name and contact details, including telephone nu mber and email ID, of the issuing authority for verification. Bids without the requisite supporting documents may be rejected during technical evaluation. e. The bidder shall submit valid authorization from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (O EM)/manufacturer for the proposed products. f. The bidder must have an established office/enterprise in India. 6. Certifications and Registrations: The bidder must possess ISO 9001:2015, EN standard, CE, MSME and NSIC certifications/registrati ons under the category of Sports Surface and Equipment, as applicable. Copies of the relevant val id certificates/registrations shall be submitted along with the technical bid. 7. Make in India: The bidder shall submit the requisite Make in India certificate/declaration in the prescribed standar d format along with the technical bid, in accordance with the Public Procurement (Preference to M ake in India) Order, 2017, as amended from time to time. 8. Blacklisting/Debarment: The bidder shall submit a declaration that the firm/company has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government Department, Government organization, Public Sector Enterprise or other com petent authority as on the date of submission of the bid. 9. Material Quality: The bidder shall ensure the use of virgin/fresh polypropylene (PP) material for manufacturing the modular tiles. The bidder shall submit the technical specifications, material composition and relev ant test certificates of the proposed PP tiles in accordance with the specifications prescribed in An nexure-A. 10. Site Inspection:

Bidders are advised to visit and inspect the proposed installation site before submission of their bi ds to assess the existing site conditions and the requirements for successful execution of the work . The existing photographs of the Outdoor Basketball Court are provided at Annexure-B for referen ce. The successful bidder shall be responsible for carrying out the minor repairs and preparatory w orks specifically required for proper installation of the flooring system, as covered under the scope of work and quoted price. 11. Compliance with Technical Specifications: The bidder shall strictly comply with all the technical specifications and requirements mentioned i n Annexure-A. Any deviation from the prescribed specifications shall be clearly indicated in the tec hnical bid. Failure to meet the prescribed technical requirements may result in rejection of the bid. 12. Payment Terms: No advance payment shall be made under any circumstances. Payment shall be released only afte r successful completion of the entire supply, installation, commissioning and testing of the Outdoo r Basketball Court, subject to inspection and satisfactory acceptance by the Institute. The successf ul bidder shall submit the invoice, original delivery challan and other requisite documents along wi th the satisfactory installation and completion certificate issued by the Indenter/competent authority, as applicable under the GeM contract. 13. Warranty and Maintenance: a. The PP modular tiles and the complete flooring system shall carry a comprehensive warr anty of at least 05 (five) years against manufacturing defects, material defects, premature deterio ration, fading, discoloration, loss of original color, cracking, breakage and other defects attributabl e to material quality or workmanship, under normal usage and maintenance conditions. b. The successful bidder shall provide comprehensive maintenance and after-sales support for a minimum period of 05 (five) years from the date of successful installation, commissioning an d acceptance of the court by the Institute. c. Any defective material or component covered under warranty shall be repaired or replac ed free of cost, including transportation, labor and installation charges, within 07 (seven) days of r eceipt of the complaint from the Institute. d. The bidder shall acknowledge complaints within 03 (three) working days of their receipt and shall provide prompt technical assistance and necessary rectification. e. The bidder shall provide an official email ID and contact number for lodging complaints and obtaining technical support throughout the warranty and maintenance periods. 14. Inspection, Testing and Quality Control: The Institute reserves the right to inspect and test the materials and equipment supplied, either b efore or during installation or after completion of the work, to ensure compliance with the prescrib ed technical specifications and quality standards. If any material or equipment is found defective, substandard or not in conformity with the approved specifications, the successful bidder shall repl ace or rectify the same at its own cost, without any additional financial liability to the Institute. Acc eptance of the materials during initial inspection shall not prejudice the Institute's right to reject a ny defective or non-conforming material subsequently detected during installation, testing or the warranty period. The decision of the Institute regarding acceptance of the supplied materials and completed work shall be binding, subject to the terms of the contract. 15. Delivery, Installation and Commissioning: The successful bidder shall arrange the supply and delivery of all materials and equipment at ABV-

IIITM, Gwalior, at its own cost and risk. The materials shall be delivered at the designated site, i.e. the Outdoor Basketball Court located near the Sports Complex of ABV-IIITM. The successful bidder shall also undertake the complete installation, commissioning, testing and marking of the basketb all court at its own cost. The entire work shall be completed within 45 (forty-five) days from the da te of issuance of the GeM contract/order. Relevant user manuals, maintenance guidelines and oth er technical documents shall be provided upon completion of the work. 16. Civil Works and Site Preparation: The existing RCC flooring shall be utilized for installation of the PP modular tiles. The successful bid der shall inspect the existing RCC surface and undertake all necessary minor civil repairs and prep aratory works, including surface levelling, minor crack repairs, slope correction and ensuring prop er water drainage, wherever required for proper installation and functioning of the PP modular tile s. The completed surface shall be even, stable and suitable for the intended sporting activity. No a dditional payment shall be admissible for such minor repair and preparatory works, which shall be deemed included in the quoted price. Construction of a new RCC flooring/base shall not be part of the scope of work. 17. Court Marking and Color Combination: The successful bidder shall provide clear and durable court markings in accordance with applicabl e FIBA specifications, to the extent practicable within the available court dimensions. The PP modu lar tiles shall be supplied and installed in suitable combinations of different colors to ensure proper demarcation of the playing area and visibility of court markings. 18. Transit Risk: The successful bidder shall be solely responsible for any loss or damage to the materials and equip ment during transportation, handling and delivery until their successful installation and acceptanc e by the Institute. 19. Acceptance of Terms and Conditions: Submission of a bid shall imply acceptance of the terms and conditions stipulated in the bid docu ment. Bids not complying with the eligibility criteria, technical specifications and other mandatory requirements may be rejected during the GeM evaluation process. 20. Security Deposit/Performance Security: The security deposit/performance security, as applicable under the GeM contract and prescribed p rocurement rules, shall be governed by the relevant terms and conditions of the contract. Its relea se shall be subject to satisfactory completion of the contractual obligations and fulfilment of the a pplicable warranty/performance security requirements. 21. General Compliance: The successful bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory requirements, safety provisions, la bour laws and other relevant rules and regulations while executing the work at the Institute's pre mises. Any damage caused to the Institute's property during execution of the work shall be made good by the successful bidder at its own cost. Annexure-A

Technical Specification for “Supply, Installation, Commissioning and Testing (SITC) of Outdoor Basketball Court Infrastructure at ABV-IIITM, Gwalior” through GeM: 1. The playing area shall measure 28 m × 15 m, within the available overall court area of 31 m × 20 m, including the surrounding safety/run-off area. The total area to be covered with tiles s hall be approximately 6,700 sq. ft. (622.45 sq. m.). 2. Each Polypropylene (PP) tile shall weigh not less than 350 grams per piece. 3. Tile Dimensions: Minimum length: 304.8 mm × Minimum width: 304.8 mm × Minimum thic kness: 15.8 mm. 4. The tile surface shall be non-slippery and the material shall be 100% recyclable. 5. The PP tile flooring system shall provide shock absorption of at least 35%. 6. The PP tile flooring system shall provide ball rebound of at least 98%. 7. The PP tiles shall have a sufficient number of interlocking locks/connectors to ensure strong a nd secure interlocking. The tile design and shape shall conform to the applicable BFI/FIBA requi rements, wherever specified. 8. The PP tiles shall have a minimum expected service life of 10 years. 9. The PP tiles shall be available in more than two colors. Different colors shall be used to ens ure better visibility and clear demarcation of the playing area. 10. The PP tiles shall carry a comprehensive product warranty of at least 5 years, including a se parate color warranty of at least 5 years against fading, discoloration or loss of original color. 11. The PP tile flooring system shall conform to the applicable standards and specifications of BFI/ FIBA, wherever relevant, and the bidder shall submit supporting compliance documents.
